feeCustodyReconciliation.claim: 685 of 1537 live curves hold more in their WSOL quote vault than the curve's quoteAmount accounting (total +6.784577154 SOL)
feeCustodyReconciliation.measurement: attacker-signer BondingCurveCollectFees on DbRKfbUmxd... moved 520,591,863 units to the privilege-1 fee authority's ATA and drove vault-vs-accounting divergence to exactly 0
feeCustodyReconciliation.conclusion: the excess is unclaimed protocol/creator fee custody, not a leak; it is not extractable by selling (payout measured 29,347 vs accounting release 29,644 and 1,002,638,546 vs 1,012,766,209 - i.e. always less), and collectFees credits only the bound fee authority

stuckRefundDestinations.claim: 31 live consumed_permission accounts (41,420,920 lamports) have refund_destination = Pubkey::default() and safe_to_close_slot in the past
stuckRefundDestinations.measurement: PermissionRefund with the attacker wallet -> 6001 'has wrong address'; with the stored (zero) destination -> 6000 'is not writable'; twice in one tx -> 6001
stuckRefundDestinations.conclusion: no attacker gain, but the rent of those accounts is unrecoverable by anyone; an unset destination should fall back to the consumer
